title: backfill BFS race: concurrent insert between has_entry check and fetch leaves advance_tips uncalled
description: backfill.rs fetch_and_apply: want_parent_ids is only set if want_id is actually fetched (Ok branch of storage.get_entry). If a concurrent caller inserts want_id between our initial has_entry=false check and the BFS storage.get_entry call, has_entry returns true in the BFS loop, we skip the fetch, want_parent_ids stays None, and advance_tips is never called. The tip set for the group is not updated despite the entry now existing. Trigger: two concurrent backfill tasks racing on the same entry.
